title: Phân hệ 1: Tài khoản, Khách hàng & Sức khỏe (Physical ERD)
code:
erDiagram
    ACCOUNT {
        int AccountID PK
        varchar Username
        varchar PasswordHash
        varchar Email
        varchar Phone
        varchar FullName
        varchar AvatarUrl
        varchar Status
        varchar Role
        varchar OtpCode
        datetime OtpExpiredAt
        varchar OtpType
        datetime CreatedAt
        varchar RefreshToken
        datetime RefreshExpiry
        bit IsTokenRevoked
    }
    MEMBER {
        int MemberID PK
        int AccountID FK
        varchar FullName
        varchar FacePath
        text FaceVector
        decimal SpendingLimit
        int TotalPoints
    }
    MEMBERSHIP {
        int MembershipID PK
        int MemberID FK
        varchar TierName
        varchar Status
    }
    HEALTH_TAG {
        int HealthTagID PK
        varchar TagName
        varchar TagType
        varchar IconName
    }
    MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE {
        int MemberID PK,FK
        int HealthTagID PK,FK
        varchar status
    }
    HEALTH_TAG_CONFLICT {
        int TagId1 PK,FK
        int TagId2 PK,FK
        varchar ErrorMessage
    }

    ACCOUNT ||--o{ MEMBER : ""
    MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBERSHIP : ""
    MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE : ""
    HEALTH_TAG ||--o{ MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE : ""
    HEALTH_TAG ||--o{ HEALTH_TAG_CONFLICT : ""
